focus: Central Phoenix: east of Downtown near I-10, the Camelback East corridor (16th St, 24th St, Thomas Rd, Camelback Rd), and the I-17 Black Canyon corridor on the west side
intro: These Phoenix listings were checked on Public Storage’s own facility pages on November 25, 2026, and cover the ten Public Storage locations the operator’s Phoenix city page lists: east of Downtown along Jefferson and Jackson Streets near I-10, the Camelback East corridor along 16th and 24th Streets, Thomas Road and Camelback Road, and three properties on the west side along the I-17 (Black Canyon Highway) corridor. We copied published access hours and office hours separately, and we only flag climate control when the facility’s own page lists it (9 of the ten do). None of these facilities published around-the-clock access hours: 3 pages show a “24/7 Access Available” badge, but nine access-hours tables are 6:00 AM–10:00 PM daily and the Camelback Road location closes at 6:00 PM on weekdays and 5:00 PM on weekends, so we recorded the tables and noted the badge. This is a starting sample from one operator, not a citywide inventory; other operators such as CubeSmart, Extra Space, and local independents are not included yet, and north Phoenix, Ahwatukee, Laveen, and the surrounding cities (Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Glendale, Chandler) are not covered. We do not cache live unit prices or vacancy.
